Package org.keycloak.services.clientpolicy.context.admin

Interface ClientProtocolMapperContext

All Superinterfaces:
ClientModelContext, ClientPolicyContext, ClientPolicyCRUDContext
All Known Implementing Classes:
ClientProtocolMapperRegisterContext, ClientProtocolMapperRemoveContext, ClientProtocolMapperUpdateContext
public interface ClientProtocolMapperContext extends ClientModelContext, ClientPolicyCRUDContext
Context fired by ProtocolMappersResource on protocol-mapper CRUD operations through the admin REST API.

Dispatched as ClientPolicyEvent.REGISTER_PROTOCOL_MAPPER, ClientPolicyEvent.UPDATE_PROTOCOL_MAPPER, and ClientPolicyEvent.UNREGISTER_PROTOCOL_MAPPER.

      default ProtocolMapperRepresentation getProposedProtocolMapper()

      the inbound mapper representation on single-item REGISTER/UPDATE flows; null on UNREGISTER and on batch REGISTER flows. Use getProposedProtocolMappers() to inspect batch payloads.

    • getProposedProtocolMappers
